_meta.note: 用户可见文案单一来源（zh/en）。C# 用 Loc.Tk(key)，Node 用 i18n.t(key)。术语见 i18n/glossary.md；不在此表里的字符串不得硬编码成用户可见文案。
_meta.keys: panel.* 面板 ｜ dialog.* 对话框 ｜ status.* 状态栏 ｜ error.* 错误 ｜ log.* 日志模板

menu.cleanCache.zh: 清理缓存文件（选择集/跨图）

menu.cleanAll.zh: 全部清理（含任务计划，长期记忆保留）
menu.cleanAll.en: Clean everything (incl. plan; long-term memory kept)

dialog.knowledgeSources.pick.zh: 选择要作为知识源的文件夹（只读，不会被修改）
dialog.knowledgeSources.pick.en: Pick a folder to use as a read-only knowledge source

dialog.knowledgeSources.saved.zh: 已保存 {n} 个知识源；回我一句「整理知识库」即可生效
dialog.knowledgeSources.saved.en: Saved {n} source(s); say “organize the knowledge base” to apply

dialog.knowledgeSources.dup.zh: 这个文件夹已经加过了
dialog.knowledgeSources.dup.en: That folder is already in the list

status.knowledgeFolderHint.zh: 把规范/PDF/Excel 放进这个文件夹，再对我说「整理知识库」
status.knowledgeFolderHint.en: Put specs / PDF / Excel in this folder, then tell me “organize the knowledge base”

status.configHint.zh: 在 knowledgeSources 里加文件夹路径（只读，不搬文件），改完说「整理知识库」
status.configHint.en: Add folder paths under knowledgeSources (read-only, nothing copied), then say “organize the knowledge base”

status.notFoundConfig.zh: 找不到 config.json（先让面板初始化一次）
status.notFoundConfig.en: config.json not found (run the palette once to initialise)

error.interactiveBlocked.zh: 交互式命令已拦截: {cmd} —— 请改用专用 API 方法
error.interactiveBlocked.en: Interactive command blocked: {cmd} — use the dedicated API method instead

error.timeout.zh: 操作超时（{sec}s），命令上下文可能被占用
error.timeout.en: Operation timed out after {sec}s — the command context may be blocked

error.hostBusy.zh: 上一个操作超时后宿主仍被占用，请稍后重试
error.hostBusy.en: The host is still busy after a previous timeout — retry later

error.fileTooLarge.zh: 文件过大（{mb} MB），上限 {limit} MB
error.fileTooLarge.en: File too large ({mb} MB), limit is {limit} MB

error.thinText.zh: 几乎无文本（{n} 字符）——疑似图形/扫描件，建议走图纸解析或 OCR
error.thinText.en: Almost no text ({n} chars) — looks like a vector/scanned file; use drawing parsing or OCR instead

error.noDrawing.zh: 当前没有打开任何图纸（Civil 3D 可能停在“开始”页）。请先 openDrawing 打开一张 dwg 或 newDrawing 新建一张，再调用需要图纸的操作。
error.noDrawing.en: No drawing is open (Civil 3D may be sitting on the Start page). Call openDrawing to open a DWG or newDrawing to create one, then retry the operation.

error.jobRunning.zh: 后台任务正在运行，命令上下文被占用。请稍候（可用 getJobStatus 查看进度），不要重复提交相同操作。
error.jobRunning.en: A background job is running and the command context is busy. Wait and poll getJobStatus for progress; do not resubmit the same operation.

error.hostBusyStale.zh: 上一个操作超时后 AutoCAD 命令上下文仍被占用。若 CAD 停在“开始”页/没有打开图纸，请先调 openDrawing 打开一张 dwg（能直接破局）；否则稍后重试，或在 CAD 里结束正在进行的操作。
error.hostBusyStale.en: The AutoCAD command context is still blocked after a previous timeout. If CAD is on the Start page or no drawing is open, call openDrawing first (that breaks the deadlock); otherwise retry later, or cancel the running command in CAD.

error.timeoutDocumentOp.zh: 操作超时 {sec}s：AutoCAD 命令上下文可能被阻塞。看门狗正在投递 ESC 尝试恢复（最长 {max}s）。若 CAD 停在“开始”页/没有活动图纸，请先调 openDrawing 打开一张 dwg（能直接破局）。[诊断: {diag}]
error.timeoutDocumentOp.en: Operation timed out after {sec}s — the AutoCAD command context may be blocked. The watchdog is sending ESC to recover (up to {max}s). If CAD is on the Start page or no drawing is active, call openDrawing first (that breaks the deadlock). [diag: {diag}]

error.timeoutCommand.zh: 操作超时 {sec}s：AutoCAD 命令上下文可能被阻塞（待处理的对话框或交互命令）。看门狗正在投递 ESC 尝试恢复（最长 {max}s），期间后续请求会快速返回 HOST_BUSY。若长时间不恢复：在 CAD 里按 ESC 关闭当前命令/对话框，或调 openDrawing 打开一张 dwg 破局；仍无效请重启 Civil 3D。[诊断: {diag}]
error.timeoutCommand.en: Operation timed out after {sec}s — the AutoCAD command context may be blocked (pending dialog or interactive command). The watchdog is sending ESC to recover (up to {max}s); meanwhile further requests fail fast with HOST_BUSY. If it does not recover: press ESC in CAD to dismiss the command/dialog, or call openDrawing to open a DWG to break the deadlock; if that fails, restart Civil 3D. [diag: {diag}]

error.interactiveBlocked2.zh: 交互式命令已拦截：{cmd} —— 请改用专用 API 方法（如 createPolyline / createCircle）；executeCommand 只允许非交互命令。
error.interactiveBlocked2.en: Interactive command blocked: {cmd} — use a dedicated API method (e.g. createPolyline / createCircle); executeCommand only accepts non-interactive commands.

error.lispTooLong.zh: LISP 脚本过长（{n} 字符，上限 400）——请拆分为多段执行，或改用专用 API 方法。
error.lispTooLong.en: LISP script too long ({n} chars, limit 400) — split it into several calls, or use a dedicated API method.

error.convToSurfaceFailed.zh: CONVTOSURFACE 失败：该对象不能转换为曲面（需要闭合曲线 / 区域 / 实体面）。
error.convToSurfaceFailed.en: CONVTOSURFACE failed: this object cannot be converted to a surface (it needs a closed curve, a region, or a solid face).

error.convToSolidFailed.zh: CONVTOSOLID 失败：该对象无法构成区域（需要闭合平面曲线：多段线 / 圆 / 椭圆）。
error.convToSolidFailed.en: CONVTOSOLID failed: this object cannot form a region (it needs a closed planar curve: polyline, circle or ellipse).

error.tooManyHandles.zh: handles 过多（{n} > 500），LISP 过滤器可能被 CAD 截断——建议分批处理，或改用 selectByCriteria。
error.tooManyHandles.en: Too many handles ({n} > 500); the LISP filter may be truncated by CAD — process in batches, or use selectByCriteria.

error.formatUnsupported.zh: format 只支持 json / csv / txt（收到：{format}）。
error.formatUnsupported.en: format must be one of json / csv / txt (got: {format}).

error.nameRequired.zh: {name} 不能为空（请传 handles 数组）。
error.nameRequired.en: {name} must not be empty (pass a handles array).

error.fileExists.zh: 文件已存在，不覆盖：{path} —— 换个文件名，或让用户删除旧文件后重试。
error.fileExists.en: File already exists, not overwriting: {path} — choose another name, or ask the user to delete the old file and retry.

error.extNotAllowed.zh: 不允许写入该扩展名：{ext}（可执行 / 脚本文件禁写）。
error.extNotAllowed.en: Extension not allowed for writing: {ext} (executable and script files are blocked).

error.paramType.zh: 参数 '{name}' 期望类型 {expect}，实际值 {actual}

error.needThreePoints.en: A loop needs at least 3 points

error.hatchNeedLoops.zh: createHatch 需要 loops:[{points,bulges?},…]（多环/带岛）或 points:[…]（单环）
error.hatchNeedLoops.en: createHatch needs loops:[{points,bulges?},…] (multiple loops / islands) or points:[…] (single loop)

error.gradientNotApplied.zh: 渐变未生效（名称可能无效）：{name}；常见可用名：LINEAR / CYLINDER / SPHERICAL / HEMISPHERICAL / CURVED
error.gradientNotApplied.en: Gradient did not apply (the name may be invalid): {name}; common names: LINEAR / CYLINDER / SPHERICAL / HEMISPHERICAL / CURVED

error.gradientNotAppliedShort.zh: 渐变未生效（名称可能无效）：{name}
error.gradientNotAppliedShort.en: Gradient did not apply (the name may be invalid): {name}

error.itemsArrayRequired.zh: items 数组必填：{items:[{loops|points, pattern?, scale?, angle?, color?, layer?}], layer?, pattern?, scale?, angle?}
error.itemsArrayRequired.en: items array is required: {items:[{loops|points, pattern?, scale?, angle?, color?, layer?}], layer?, pattern?, scale?, angle?}

error.editHatchNothing.zh: editHatch 至少要给一个要改的项：pattern/scale/angle/color/layer/islandStyle/origin/loops/gradient/gradientAngle/gradientColors/shadeTint
error.editHatchNothing.en: editHatch needs at least one field to change: pattern/scale/angle/color/layer/islandStyle/origin/loops/gradient/gradientAngle/gradientColors/shadeTint

error.notHatch.en: This handle is not a hatch (HATCH): {h}

error.noIntersectionTrim.zh: 目标曲线与剪切边没有交点，无法修剪。
error.noIntersectionTrim.en: The target curve has no intersection with the cutting edge — cannot trim.

error.splitFailed.zh: 切开失败（未产生足够的分段）。
error.splitFailed.en: Split failed — it did not produce enough segments.

error.extendNoIntersection.zh: 目标曲线延伸后仍与边界无交点。
error.extendNoIntersection.en: The target curve still has no intersection with the boundary after extension.

error.linesParallel.zh: 两条直线平行或共线，无法倒角/圆角。
error.linesParallel.en: The two lines are parallel or collinear — cannot chamfer/fillet.

error.onlyLineLine.zh: 当前仅支持直线-直线（Line-Line）的圆角/倒角。
error.onlyLineLine.en: Only line-to-line fillet/chamfer is supported for now.

error.angleDegenerate.zh: 两直线夹角退化为 0°/180°，无法圆角/倒角。
error.angleDegenerate.en: The angle between the lines degenerates to 0°/180° — cannot fillet/chamfer.

error.sectionPlanePoints.zh: sectionPlane 需要 points[[x,y],…] ≥3 个点（定义剖切线）。
error.sectionPlanePoints.en: sectionPlane needs points[[x,y],…] with at least 3 points (to define the section line).

error.configNotObject.zh: config.json 不是有效对象，已中止（避免覆盖你的配置）
error.configNotObject.en: config.json is not a valid JSON object — aborted to avoid overwriting your configuration

error.imageDecodeFailed.zh: 无法解码图片 {name}：文件可能已损坏，或不是受支持的图片格式（支持 png/jpg/gif/bmp/tiff/webp）。（{msg}）
error.imageDecodeFailed.en: Cannot decode image {name}: the file may be corrupted or an unsupported format (supported: png/jpg/gif/bmp/tiff/webp). ({msg})

error.encoderNotFound.zh: 系统中找不到该格式的编码器：{fmt}
error.encoderNotFound.en: No image encoder found on this system for: {fmt}

error.saveFailedReadOnly.zh: 保存失败（{msg}）。常见原因：图纸以只读方式打开（重复打开同一 DWG 会产生 ":2 只读" 副本）。请关掉只读副本，再用 openDrawing 以可写方式重开：{path}
error.saveFailedReadOnly.en: Save failed ({msg}). A common cause is that the drawing is open read-only (opening the same DWG twice creates a ":2 read-only" copy). Close the read-only copy, then reopen it writable with openDrawing: {path}

error.layerNotFound.zh: 图层不存在：{name} —— 请先用 createLayer 创建，或核对图层名。
error.layerNotFound.en: Layer not found: {name} — create it with createLayer first, or check the layer name.

error.pdfUnreadable.zh: 无法解析 PDF（可能已加密 / 损坏 / 不是 PDF）：{msg}
error.pdfUnreadable.en: Cannot parse the PDF (it may be encrypted, corrupted, or not a PDF): {msg}

status.pdfTextLayerOnly.zh: PDF 文本层抽取（扫描件没有文本层 → 内容可能为空；当前版本不做 OCR）
status.pdfTextLayerOnly.en: PDF text-layer extraction only (a scanned PDF has no text layer, so the content may be empty; OCR is not performed in this version)

error.surfaceNoValidPoints.zh: 文件未解析到有效点（请检查 delimiter / hasHeader / 列序参数）：{path}
error.surfaceNoValidPoints.en: No valid points were parsed from the file (check delimiter / hasHeader / column indices): {path}

error.surfaceGridNoExtents.zh: 网格法失败：两个曲面的范围（GeometricExtents）都不可用。
error.surfaceGridNoExtents.en: Grid method failed: the extents (GeometricExtents) of both surfaces are unavailable.

error.surfaceNoOverlap.zh: 两个曲面的 XY 范围不重叠，无法计算体积。
error.surfaceNoOverlap.en: The two surfaces do not overlap in XY — volume cannot be computed.

error.tinVolumeUnsupported.zh: TinVolumeSurface 创建失败（Civil 3D 不支持廊道曲面参与体积曲面计算）：{msg}
error.tinVolumeUnsupported.en: Failed to create the TinVolumeSurface (Civil 3D does not allow corridor surfaces in a volume surface computation): {msg}

error.surfaceNotCorridor.zh: 曲面 '{name}' 不是廊道曲面，无需烘焙。
error.surfaceNotCorridor.en: Surface '{name}' is not a corridor surface — no baking needed.

error.styleParamRequired.zh: {method} 需要参数 'style'。（Profile 标签集只能在创建时指定；纵断面图的带集请用 setProfileViewStyle）
error.styleParamRequired.en: {method} requires the 'style' parameter. (A profile label set can only be set at creation time; use setProfileViewStyle for profile view bands.)

error.handleBadFormat.zh: handle 格式非法：{handle}（应为十六进制，如 1A2B）
